tasks.title: Create a Book Model
tasks.description: Define a Book model with title, author, published_year, and isbn fields. Then create and apply migrations.

tasks.title: Query the Library
tasks.description: Using the Book model, write queries to find books published after 2000, update a book's title, and delete a book.

tasks.title: Add Relationships
